contexts.text: Nor apprehends by fancy.
To live from the Lord they think is phantasies.
Pleasant to the eyes = phantasy.
Their phantasies are lulled...
Sons (then) = phantasies.
In place of perception succeeded a most obstinate and deadly phantasy.
An inundation into the left side of the brain with direful phantasies...
That they served cupidities and phantasies. Signified.
Pitch = direful phantasies.
Reasonings from phantasies. Signified.
Their phantasies thence have to them the reality of life.
Are (there) turned into infernal phantasies and penalties.
They are turned into direful phantasies. AC 939.
They have the phantasy that the universe is an orb which they walk round...
(The phantasy as of a great sea heaving with billows.) Explained.
Phantasies which have been in the life of the body, are (there) turned into others, which correspond. Example(s).
The punishment of the veil is caused by phantasy. Explained.
Their principles of falsity are (there) turned into phantasies. Described. AC 1111.
A misty rock which bursts forth from their direful phantasies and persuasions.
This (rolling up) is effected by phantasies. Explained.
Their cruel phantasies against the Lord. SE 3366. Explained.
Evil Spirits are kept together by being bound by like phantasies and cupidities.
Watch towers = phantasies.
(Spirits, by phantasies, appear anywhere.) Described.
I saw some things produced by phantasy, which were aerial... He had had ideas that all things are only phantasies...
The spheres of phantasies, when presented to view, appear like clouds...
The life of their phantasies appears as (such) light...
The human proprium is attended with such phantasies...
They keep the thought in one Thing, and thus infill it with phantasies...

They did see (visions) but in phantasy... There are Spirits who induce such appearances by phantasies... If anything is seen in shadow... they keep the mind fixed in the thought of some Thing... and (thus) the phantasy is increased... and he sees just as if the things were there... Such things befall those who indulge much in phantasies... SE 1752.

Evil Spirits are scarcely anything but cupidities and phantasies... Their phantasies are such that they have no perception but that it is so. The phantasies of men cannot be compared with theirs... Such phantasies are perpetual with the infernals, where the one miserably torments the other by means of phantasies.
Every one reasoned according to his phantasy which he had contracted (here).
Those in that light are in phantasies; and the things they see in the phantasies they believe to be truths... Their phantasies are also bound to filthy and obscene objects...
Persuasive phantasy (there) counterfeits the position (where they are).
On account of the contumacy which was in their phantasies and cupidities. Signified, Explained.
Falsities are phantasies, because they are of phantasies.
The quality of the phantasies (of the Jews). (Explained.)
They themselves... are nothing but phantasies as to the thoughts; and to see anything from phantasies is to see real things as not real, and things not real as real.
They there appear to themselves from phantasy as Spirits not evil.
The valley of vision = phantasies concerning spiritual things from sensuous ones.
By phantasies they form many kinds of rods.
The interior man is in the power... of not willing and thinking what the exterior man sees from phantasy...
A rod avails within the Hells of magicians, because illusions and phantasies reign.

These arts correspond to the phantasies by which the evil (there) present beautiful things as foul, and foul ones as beautiful; which phantasies are a species of sorceries; for they, too, are abuses of Divine order.
In place of perception (such) have phantasy...
All these things [are done] by art through phantasies. Described.
Evil Spirits... destroy as to soul and body (those men) who have indulged ranch in phantasies...
Such are immersed in marshes, where they are harassed by the phantasies into which their falsities are turned.
When the light of Heaven inflows into the falsities of evil, it is turned into... phantasies of various kinds.
Operations by phantasies (one of the infernal arts).
The phantasies of those who want to be invoked as gods. Described.
To be neither in Heaven nor in Hell; but in a place... where there are nothing but phantasies. Signified.
The ultimates of life... when separated from the interiors of life, are mere phantasies.
Their phantasies concerning faith alone as if it were in power. Signified, Explained.
The ideal thoughts which are called phantasies.
All these things were induced... by means of phantasies. Explained.
By means of phantasies infernal Spirits can represent magnificent things by closing the interiors of the mind, and opening its exteriors alone.
The phantasy that they were the patriarchs, etc.
This mist was an aura of phantasy...
Thou art insane from the phantasy of supereminence.
I did not want to say. Thou art insane, because he was insane from phantasy.
You laboured under the phantasy that you had the keys...
Everyone in Hell is left to his own phantasy...
The images of their phantasies appeared thus to me.
Those in the phantasy of possessing the things of the world.
They were conversing about phantasy, concupiscence, and intelligence. Explained.

I asked whether all in concupiscence are in the phantasy thereof. They replied, Those are in the phantasy of their concupiscence who think inwardly in themselves, and indulge their imagination too much, by talking to themselves. Explained.
Those who from the love of the world are in the visionary concupiscence, or phantasy, of possessing all wealth. Described.
Lest we enter into the mist of their phantasy ...
The pupils of their eyes flashed in a green plane, which was from the light of phantasy.
They had magnified the grains of gold by their common united phantasy.
Harlots who by phantasy can induce on themselves pre-eminent beauty... The phantasy induced from Heaven is then taken away...
They are then in phantasy; and phantasy appears to fly.

Sirens know how by phantasies to induce on themselves... forms of beauty and adornment. Described... Such are harlots (there), and study phantasies. Phantasy is effected by sensuous thought, while ideas from any interior thought are closed.
In their fancy these are devils.
Has introduced (it) into the imaginations of men.
These things were induced on that statue by phantasy.
What wise man... would not say, Alas, what a phantasy!
As infants learn to prattle... there arises something obscure, belonging to fancy.
They cannot but be harassed by phantasies...
The phantasy of this love carries their minds away...
From the illusion of phantasy, they seemed in lovely forms.
What man would become in his phantasy, if a New Church were not instaurated...
That diabolical Spirits, by their phantasies, inflict... tortures on themselves, and on men.
That various phantasies follow Souls from (this) life, Enumerated.
That the phantasies of the natural man, after Souls have been created anew, are turned into human images.
All phantasies... from the love of the body... have with them filthy animals...
That it is only phantasies which cause them so to appear; and such phantasies that the Souls cannot possibly discern them from realities. Explained.
That idolaters... are ruled (there) by wonderful phantasies, and are thus devastated.
That unless Souls retain their phantasies, and are led by their phantasies, they cannot be led to Knowledges...

The natural mind, full of so many phantasies, is not broken; that is, its phantasies cannot be at once extinguished; for... no sensitive life would remain, because it is composed of mere phantasies. Explained.
That he is placed in the zenith is mere phantasy, for by phantasies he can be thrust down, etc.
a. Concerning phantasies: how they are put off, and what kind remain.
Phantasies are put off with resistance; namely, the grosser ones which are of the body, and the natural ones of the soul; but the interior ones remain...
Such as are the phantasies of a man, such are the Spirits adjoined to him. Explained.
Concerning the effect of phantasy. General article.
Souls who suppose themselves in the body, or who are in corporeal phantasies...
(Thus) so long as man is not in the Truth of faith, he is made up of phantasies.

Unless the Lord took away their phantasies, their bodily things would remain in their minds, and they would he tortured much more severely than in the body; for evil Spirits... not only have such phantasies, but also impress the like upon the minds of those whom they torture...

Phantasies reign with all those who constitute the externals of man... Such phantasies or insanities are very numerous... They are tortured until such phantasies have been moderated so as to constitute an equilibrium.
The Soul's phantasies are thus as it were exterminated... yet remain, and imitate the circle made by the saliva in digestion...
Whatever is in the phantasy of man, comes into the phantasy of Spirits, and they are persuaded that it is so. Example(s).

I have wondered... that such ideas, which are mere phantasies... should have the same effect as the senses have in the body; for... the (Spirits) actually feel the pains... Therefore they could not know why they should be called phantasies... But, when they receive faith from the Lord, they... can be taken away...
Their phantasies are turned into pleasant species of representations...
David is acute, or pernicious, because his phantasy [reaches] higher than others.
It is forbidden to induce on themselves in Hell (the idea of torment by fire) by phantasies, because they are then tortured most grievously; for they are intensely horrified at the phantasy of fire.
Concerning the quarters whither phantasies take them.
They were told that it is a phantasy (that they are carried in chariots)... Then one said that it is not a phantasy (that he has the body), because he feels his hand touching it... (See SE 3172.)
The reason the phantasies of men are (there) turned into appearances of animals, and the like. Explained.
Certain... were elevated into a higher region... and appeared behind a cloud... for this is permitted to those who have the phantasy that they can rule all others.
They (then) came into the phantasies which they had had (here), that to speak with Spirits is a phantasy...
Meanwhile they were held in their phantasy, which they wanted to derive to others...
How difficult (therefore) it is for a man to put off the phantasies which he has acquired, and confirmed (here).
That through the phantasies of others. Spirits scarcely know but that they are as they are presented.
From the phantasy of others, I was among them... As I did not know that it was a phantasy I as it were saw myself with them...

The reason Spirits are carried on high, and in a moment into the deep... is that there is a change of Societies, which are adjoined through the phantasies of others... Sometimes the phantasy of one, together with his associates, forcibly drives another on high, or into the deep; but this is only apparently so; whereas when their phantasy adjoins itself, then there is a translation according to the phantasy.
What are phantasies, and what are imaginations. Explained.
That man seems to live from himself... is such a phantasy...
Angelic representations are not, although they appear; (but as) they = Truths... they are not phantasies; for they feel and are delighted with them inmostly...

Such is the conflict of the phantasies from the external senses with reason... The reason they were seen afar off, was that the Rational of man is hidden within when phantasies reign... Meanwhile the man who is in phantasies is in a state as it were tranquil...
There is a perceptible sphere of every phantasy.
(The Antediluvians) labour with their phantasies. Described.
They operated... by direful phantasies. Described.
For phantasies operate together with cupidities.
They acted towards the left side of the breast, thus by phantasies from cupidities; thus not with phantasies without them...
When I was thinking... he had such phantasies that... he perceived not a whit of my idea... (See also SE 3401. SE 3410. SE 3413. SE 3414. SE 3416.)
Philosophers who have taken up phantasies concerning Spirits...
That the learned who have taken up phantasies, see nothing except what confirms them.
He wanted to conjoin by phantasy the innocent with himself...
They had inrooted phantasies so that...
How men fall into... direful phantasies.
When I was led by them into such phantasies... SE 3482.
While kept in the phantasy that they were outside the universe...
The phantasy of confounding the Divine infinite with the infinite of space.
The phantasy concerning the creation of the world... This phantasy, once imbued... easily recurs, and thus reigns.
b. The quality of the phantasies of deceitful Genii. Explained.
This idea, being their filthy phantasy, (caused them to seem to be like it).
Man is so carried along by his cupidities, which produce phantasies...
From (the reflections of thought) come... insanities and phantasies... Those in solitude of life easily fall into such things...

Some have so inrooted their phantasies that... they are completely immersed in them... These are called open insanities; for they do not suffer themselves to be removed from this insanity or phantasy, appearing sane in all other things... All phantasies concerning spiritual things originate thence, in so far as they have induced persuasion.
(The phantasies of those in the interior sphere.)
Phantasy can cause him to appear above when he is below, and so on.
For one phantasy produces another.
By phantasy it was induced that with these knives they would cut my throat; for evil Spirits are such, that in phantasy, they suppose themselves to be in the act.
(The direful phantasies of Sirens, represented.)
The Quakers inhere obstinately in their phantasies...

The Quaker Spirits rushed by phantasies upon an innocent person; but, as they acted by phantasies they could not excite him... Such a phantasy may be called an illusive phantasy, when they suppose it to be him, when it is nothing but their phantasy... So that there is no other subject, but only a phantasy thus formed into his image, which, also, is an aerial phantasy...
They elevated me among themselves by phantasy...
By phantasies Spirits can present anything to view in another place...
They contrived how to produce infants by phantasies... and thus infuse the phantasy that he is a husband.
See Persuade.
That distances are phantasies...
That they appear so very high up, is a phantasy of their altitude...
When the phantasy of magic and deceit comes, they seem to be elsewhere... But still they are in Hell; for the other place is only a phantasy.
He becomes as one dead; for nothing corresponds to his phantasies.
An inundation is twofold... of phantasies on the left side of the head. Explained. (Compare AC 5725.)
They want to obsess man, whence come the direful phantasies of man...
On those who suppose all things to be phantasies... and that there is nothing real.

Concerning phantasies. - It is wonderful that the phantasies of evil Spirits should appear as quite real... They touched their garments... and said that they were real; but they can be taken away by phantasies, and others put on... All things which are from the Lord are real, and those who are from Spirits are not real... as a man who is in phantasies supposes evil to be good... If phantasies had not a semblance of reality, [these Spirits] could not be; for they are mere phantasies... But good Spirits have no such phantasies.
Concerning hypocrites, and their phantasies, (Troops of fleas.)
Where nothing is believed to be true, there is nothing but phantasy which is produced in its place.

Concerning phantasies. - The phantasies with Spirits are as it were alive. They suppose they have garments... The reason is that they [themselves] are mere phantasies, and their life consists of nothing but phantasies, because of falsities. In order that they may live, it has been provided... that their phantasies should appear to them as if they really existed. But with those who are in faith from the Lord there are no phantasies; but appearances attended with all delight and happiness. Explained.
On the phantasies which reign in Hell.
If they had not a life of phantasies, they would have none at all; and therefore phantasies are to them as it were living, with every sense... They said they knew they were phantasies...
The genera of phantasies are very numerous, and the species still more so; and the Hells are the same in number... I have seen how they mutually torture each other by phantasies. Example(s).
(The phantasy that they possess treasures.)
As they are permitted to act according to their phantasies and cupidities...
She thought that by phantasies she would enter into my (bodily organs)...
After death. Souls do not at once come into their consociations, because their phantasies are not those of their cupidities. Explained. SE 4487.
(Punishments in Hell by phantasies.)
Subjects whom they multiplied by phantasies...
They have the phantasy that if they could by phantasies eject the filthy things in them, they would be free from all sins; but they were shown that this is a phantasy. Example(s).
He had made these things for himself by phantasy. Enumerated.
Concerning elevation into Heaven by phantasies.
They made, from phantasy, as it were the Sun, where the Lord is.
The Dutch know better than others what is phantasy, and what real appearance...
They call those who change their garments and faces according to the quarters, phantastics.
They adored that phantastical Sun...
The phantasies of Hell.
They torture each other... by phantasies. By phantasies they make them into any monsters whatever.

By phantasies Sirens induce on themselves lovely forms, and most ornate garments. They present beautiful houses... But, as they are (mere) external forms, they perish in a moment, and then foul things are presented to view. SE 5225, Described.
(The Russians) operate very strongly by phantasies...
b. By phantasies they induce ways and streets.
b. They had made use of phantasies to procure for themselves an image of Heaven...
The quality of magical and phantastical things. Explained. SE 5802.
Concerning phantasy such as is in Hell: All things which appear in the Hells... appear real, because they themselves are in phantasy. Example(s).
They had raised themselves up into the mountains and hills by phantasies...
I wanted to speak with (the infernals), but they could not understand, because they were in phantasies...

When the spiritual are speaking in this way, they are still not in phantasies; but if they are in evil, then, when they are let into their interiors, and come into Hell, they are in phantasies. Explained.
Concerning phantasies. - The quality of phantasies was evident from a certain one who was in phantasies. Described.
As their thought is of falsity, and is then phantastical...
They see things which are not, exactly as if they were, which is the reason there are mere phantasies there, and nothing real.
By phantasies the evil ascend on high, and then believe they are in Heaven.
Concerning those who are in phantasy. Kalsenius.
Melancthon found out how by phantastical art to make appearances of decorations.
Concerning the cruelty of some by fire and tow in phantasy.
The light of phantasy is when there are falsities; the light of persuasion when there are truths.
As they revolve (the ascent of mountains) in their phantasy, they attempt it... In phantasy they cast themselves on high...
From these persuasions come forth phantastical visions.
Unreal visions... are produced by Spirits by phantasies...

In the Spiritual World there are also appearances which are not correspondences, which are produced chiefly by evil Spirits by phantasies. (Palaces, garments, etc.) But as soon as the phantasy ceases, all these things vanish, because they are external things in which there is nothing internal. Such visions, being from phantasies, = fallacies.

Hence Heaven from its light inflows through the spiritual mind (of these profaners) into things not corresponding, and into things opposite thereto, in the natural man, from which comes forth a phantasy so direful that they seem to themselves to fly in the air like dragons, while Hakes and chaff appear to them like giants and troops; and a little ball like the whole globe... The cause is that they have Heaven in the spiritual mind, and Hell in the natural... (They are in a perpetual delirium of phantasy. AE 1055:4.)

(These lascivious women) know how to make themselves beautiful by phantasies and also how to decorate places with various utensils; but only for a few moments; for, when the phantasy ceases, the appearances cease, and then all things are foul.
